ValidationRule.description: TS-4942 - Validation on the Verification number field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_QAC_Contact_Verification_Num_Length__c = FALSE, RecordType.DeveloperName == "Non_Agency_Contact", NOT(ISBLANK(Verification_Number__c)), OR( LEN(Verification_Number__c) < 10, NOT(ISNUMBER(Verification_Number__c))), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Verification_Number__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Verification Number should accept only numbers which is of 10 digits
